test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following conclusions can be logically drawn from the statement?

"All apples are fruits. Some fruits are sour."

options.text: Some fruits may not be apples.

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Statement: All apples are fruits. Some fruits are sour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5be46beb0541af9ecb59b243357d3277a278376cc29b936132bd75eb23b66f31.png] 

 

I. Some fruits may not be apples - **True** (Because only "some" fruits are mentioned as sour, and there is no restriction that all fruits are apples).

II. Some apples are not fruits - **False** (All apples are fruits as given in the statement).

III. All sour things are fruits - **False** (Statement only mentions some fruits are sour, not all sour things).

IV. All apples are sour - **False** (Nothing in the statement indicates apples are sour).

Hence, only conclusion I follows.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
